description: Source code implementing expression parsing, manipulation, and evaluation functions for a configuration system, including expression allocation, copying, freeing, comparison, transformation, and printing.

methods.name: expr_alloc_symbol
methods.description: Allocates a new expression node representing a symbol.

methods.name: expr_alloc_one
methods.description: Allocates a new expression node of a given type with a single subexpression.

methods.name: expr_alloc_two
methods.description: Allocates a new expression node of a given type with two subexpressions.

methods.name: expr_alloc_comp
methods.description: Allocates a comparison expression node between two symbols.

methods.name: expr_alloc_and
methods.description: Creates an AND expression from two subexpressions.

methods.name: expr_alloc_or
methods.description: Creates an OR expression from two subexpressions.

methods.name: expr_copy
methods.description: Deep copies an expression node.

methods.name: expr_free
methods.description: Frees an expression node and its subexpressions.

methods.name: expr_eq
methods.description: Checks if two expressions are equivalent.

methods.name: expr_eliminate_yn
methods.description: Simplifies expressions involving boolean symbols YES/NO.

methods.name: expr_eliminate_dups
methods.description: Eliminates duplicate subexpressions.

methods.name: expr_transform
methods.description: Transforms expressions, simplifying boolean logic and negations.

methods.name: expr_contains_symbol
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains a specific symbol.

methods.name: expr_depends_symbol
methods.description: Checks if an expression depends on a specific symbol.

methods.name: expr_trans_compare
methods.description: Translates expressions into comparison forms with a symbol.

methods.name: expr_calc_value
methods.description: Calculates the tristate value of an expression.

methods.name: expr_get_leftmost_symbol
methods.description: Returns the leftmost symbol in an expression.

methods.name: expr_simplify_unmet_dep
methods.description: Returns the leftmost symbol of a subexpression not depending on a given symbol.

methods.name: expr_print
methods.description: Prints an expression using a callback function.

methods.name: expr_fprint
methods.description: Prints an expression to a FILE stream.

methods.name: expr_gstr_print
methods.description: Prints an expression to a string buffer.
